instruction: Set the font size of all text elements to 18pt using the Slide Master settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text font sizes to 18pt via Slide Master view. The custom getter extracts explicit font sizes from slide content, tracks whether text inherits from Slide Master, and crucially reads the default font sizes from the Slide Master itself. The metric performs comprehensive verification: (1) When all text inherits (no explicit sizes), it verifies the Slide Master default sizes are actually 18pt; (2) When there are explicit sizes, all must be 18pt; (3) When there's a mix, both explicit sizes and Slide Master defaults must all be 18pt. This prevents false positives where inherited text already existed at a different size.

llm_judge_reasons: FIXED: Getter now extracts Slide Master default font sizes via prs.slide_masters (lines 39-48), addressing the previous critical false positive issue
FIXED: Metric Case 1 now verifies Slide Master defaults are 18pt (lines 33-48), not just checking inheritance without verification
LOGICAL CORRECTNESS: Case 2 (explicit/mixed) verifies both explicit sizes AND Slide Master defaults are 18pt (lines 50-70)
COVERAGE: Evaluator checks the actual outcome (18pt font size) in all scenarios: all-inherited, all-explicit, and mixed

MINOR LIMITATION: Slide Master extraction reads font sizes from shape text runs, which may miss placeholder-level or theme-level default formatting definitions. However, this approach will work correctly for most typical LibreOffice Impress presentations where Slide Master shapes contain text examples
EDGE CASE HANDLING: Returns 0.0 when master_default_sizes is empty in Case 1 (line 48), preventing false positives when extraction fails
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: OPTIONAL ENHANCEMENT: Consider also reading placeholder formatting definitions from Slide Master layouts, not just text runs in shapes, to capture more complete default formatting
OPTIONAL ENHANCEMENT: Could add more robust extraction that checks theme-level font definitions in presentation.xml for comprehensive coverage
validation.fix_description: Fixed the critical false positive issue. Updated getter to extract Slide Master default font sizes using prs.slide_masters. Updated metric to verify actual font sizes: Case 1 (all inherited) now checks that Slide Master defaults are 18pt, failing if they cannot be verified or are wrong; Case 2 (explicit or mixed) verifies all explicit sizes and Slide Master defaults are 18pt. This ensures the evaluator checks the actual outcome (18pt font size) not just the method (inheritance).
